Converts BigQuery SQL into optimized, governed Databricks logic.

### [DP2Bricks](https://syrencloud.com/databricks-brickbuilder-solutions-dp2bricks/)

Shifts Dataproc workloads to Databricks unified compute.

Converts Airflow DAGs into Databricks Workflows.

Converts Alteryx workflows into Databricks code in minutes.

Converts Power BI dashboards into governed Databricks AI/BI.

Automatically converts Trino, MySQL, Athena, etc into Databricks SQL.

Migrates Synapse warehouses to Databricks Lakehouse.

Converts job compute to Serverless, automatically.
